description: This file defines the SugarWidgetFieldInt class, a specialized widget for handling integer fields within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM reporting framework. It includes methods for displaying list views, generating SQL filter clauses, rendering input fields, and handling display logic for integer report fields.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldInt
classes.description: A widget class designed for handling integer fields in reports, providing display and filtering functionalities.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Returns the list view display for the integer field.

methods.name: queryFilterEquals
methods.description: Generates a SQL WHERE clause fragment for equality filtering on the integer field.

methods.name: queryFilterNot_Equals
methods.description: Generates a SQL WHERE clause fragment for inequality filtering.

methods.name: queryFilterGreater
methods.description: Generates a SQL WHERE clause fragment for greater-than filtering.

methods.name: queryFilterLess
methods.description: Generates a SQL WHERE clause fragment for less-than filtering.

methods.name: queryFilterBetween
methods.description: Generates a SQL WHERE clause fragment for between filtering.

methods.name: queryFilterStarts_With
methods.description: Alias for equals filter, potentially for pattern matching logic in context.

methods.name: displayInput
methods.description: Renders an HTML input element for entering integer filter values.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles display logic, including handling of field precision, although the reference to $obj appears incomplete or unused.
